nodes.name: 01 - Webhook - Publish Request
nodes.notes: Entry point: POST /webhook/social/publish. Contract: account_id, channel_id, content, media, publish_mode, scheduled_at, timezone.

nodes.name: 10 - Route - Validation Gate
nodes.notes: Single stop point: any validation failure means Buffer is never called.

nodes.name: 14 - Buffer - Create Post
nodes.notes: neverError=true: HTTP 4xx/5xx/429 return on the normal output with a status code so node 14 can classify them. Only genuine transport failures use the error output (node 19). The API key lives in the n8n credential and never appears in this workflow.

nodes.name: 16 - Route - Buffer Result
nodes.notes: SUCCESS -> 20, RETRY -> 16 (bounded 5xx retry only), ERROR -> 21, extra -> 21

nodes.name: 17 - Buffer - Retry Post (5xx only)
nodes.notes: Reached only for a retryable Buffer server error (HTTP 5xx or UnexpectedError). Transport timeouts are deliberately NOT retried: Buffer has no idempotency key, so retrying an ambiguous timeout could duplicate a post. Maximum two attempts per request.
